hookups.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/orlando-nw-orange-blossom/amenities/ ('50 Max Amp', 'All Sites Flat With Full Hookups') + https://koa.com/campgrounds/orlando-nw-orange-blossom/site-type/rv-camping-sites/ (site types '... 50/30/20 AMPS, FULL HOOKUPS'), read 2026-10-21 in a browser

values.note: Paved, level pull-thrus 75-100 ft long, plus back-in and deluxe back-in patio sites. Back-in sites take at most a double-axle RV and 2 vehicles (no triple axles; trailers and tow dollies go to storage, fee may apply).

sites.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/orlando-nw-orange-blossom/amenities/ ("100' Max Length") + https://koa.com/campgrounds/orlando-nw-orange-blossom/site-type/rv-camping-sites/ ('Spacious 75' to 100' long, paved, level sites') + https://koa.com/campgrounds/orlando-nw-orange-blossom/general-information/ (Back-in sites), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 24-hour laundry, free Wi-Fi, pool open year-round, rec hall/activity center, RV storage area.

facilities.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/orlando-nw-orange-blossom/amenities/ ('24 Hour Laundry', 'Free Wi-Fi', 'Pool (Open Year-Round)', 'RV Storage Area'), read 2026-10-21

season.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/orlando-nw-orange-blossom/amenities/ ('Open All Year') + general information ('We are open all year round'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Book on koa.com or 407-886-3260. After the office closes at 5 p.m., night registration outside the store shows the sites free that night: park, set up, register next morning. Stays of 27+ days by phone (RVs preferably 10 years or newer).

booking.source: https://koa.com/campgrounds/orlando-nw-orange-blossom/general-information/ (Night Registration: 'You will be able to see what sites are available for the night, park and set up, and then come into the store the next morning to get registered'; Extended Stay Limits), read 2026-10-21

note: KOA Journey at 3800 W Orange Blossom Trail (US 441), Apopka, under tall oaks; a quieter base for the Orlando theme parks. --Claude
